brief: 5 steps to fall asleep faster on anxious nights.

slots.searchQuery: How to fall asleep when anxious

slots.body: Set your phone aside and dim every light an hour before you plan to sleep.
Place one hand on your heart and breathe in for four counts, then out for six.
Tense each muscle group for five seconds, then release from your toes to your forehead.
Picture a quiet garden and walk slowly through it, letting each step feel heavier.
Write every worry onto paper until your mind feels lighter and the page holds them instead.
Whisper a gentle mantra like 'I am safe' and let it repeat until your eyes close.

slots.headline: Let the night hold you
slots.body: Return to these steps whenever rest feels far away; sleep will find you again.
